rng_note: numpy SeedSequence([base_entropy, seed]).spawn(5) in rng_streams order; streams depend on seed only (shared across conditions). dsm stream spawns n_restarts+1 children: one per restart, last for the fixed evaluation noise batch.
qr_sign_rule: Q <- Q * sign(diag(R)), sign(0)=+1, so diag(R) >= 0

dsm.t_sampling: one t per batch, uniform over dsm_t
dsm.batch_sampling: batch_size distinct train indices per update, uniform without replacement
dsm.eval_batch: validation set x each t in dsm_t with fixed eps

selection.em: final iterate of each restart, min validation NLL
selection.dsm: restart x checkpoint (500..5000), min validation NLL
